_about: wai-wad (Phase 6, Task 4). doc_types and wad_types are the Evidence Links types read as 'work as imagined' (documents) and 'work as done' (witness statements, log records, recordings). counterfactual lists the patterns that mark a counterfactual sentence in a finding's justification (Ruling P6-6): the JC3 patterns of lint-terms.json plus the phrases below. Python regular expressions, matched case-insensitively. Words are data: edit the lists here, not the code.

notes.no_wad: This export has no witness statement, log record or recording linked to a finding, so there is no work-as-done evidence to set against the documents. Collect it before using these prompts.
notes.no_pairs: No code has both document and work-as-done evidence, so there is no gap to compare.
notes.no_evidence: This workspace has no evidence items (no Evidence Links rows).
notes.no_counterfactual: No finding's justification uses counterfactual wording.
